warnings: *** THIS COMPLETES THE OPENING VOCABULARY THE PLAN AND ELEVATION FILES WERE DEFERRED TO. *** Together with A-14 the set has exactly eight door types (ป1-ป8) and nine window types (น1-น9), seventeen marks in all. Every plan and elevation file in this house (A-04, A-05, A-06, A-07, A-08) recorded rooms and levels but deliberately left the circled ป/น tags untranscribed because the glyphs are ~10 px on those sheets. The vocabulary is now fixed; assigning a mark to each opening on each plan still needs the full-size sheets and is the one piece of architectural work this extraction has not done.

EVERY WINDOW IN THE HOUSE IS ALUMINIUM - วงกบ and กรอบบาน both, on all nine types, against A-14 where only ป1 is aluminium and the other seven doors are timber. That is consistent with A-14's window ironmongery list, which names four aluminium leaf types and no timber one.

SILL AND HEAD LEVELS ARE RECORDED BECAUSE THEY VARY AND THEY MATTER. Six of the nine sit on a 0.85 m sill with a 2.05 m head, which is the house standard. The three exceptions are real: น5 is a small high light at 1.45 m sill, น7 has a 1.60 m head instead of 2.05, and น8 drops to a 0.35 m sill - the lowest in the set, a near-floor-level opening. All are measured from the floor of the room they serve, not from the building datum.

น2 AND น8 PRINT ONLY AN OVERALL WIDTH AND ITS INTERNAL DIVISION, no separate leaf width, because they combine an opening leaf with fixed panels: น2 is 0.30 + 1.10 + 0.30 = 1.80 and น8 is 0.30 + 0.80 + 0.30 = 1.50 with a further 0.50 side panel. Both divisions close exactly. width_mm holds the frame overall and the split is kept in the note; no leaf_width_mm is invented for them.

TWO GLAZING TYPES ARE USED AND THE SPLIT IS DELIBERATE: กระจกใส (clear) on น1-น5 and น9, กระจกเขียวใส (green tinted) on น6, น7 and น8. Both are 5 mm. Recorded per window rather than as one project-wide value.

THE ALUMINIUM SECTION THICKNESSES ARE MINIMA, NOT SIZES: sliding track 3" at not less than 1.8 mm, sliding leaf frame not less than 1.5 mm, awning leaf frame 2.0 mm, frame 1 3/4"x3" at 1.8 mm, swing-door leaf frame 2.5 mm. Recorded verbatim as notes; they are specification limits and do not belong on any individual window element.
Windows are recorded with element_type window and the printed Thai น marks as element_id, per §0.1 and §0.3 - not normalised to a W-series.
